notes: §1985:X.4.5.2 prints the clause as 'IS EXTERNAL', IS optional; it is written on file description entries and Working-Storage 01 entries (§1985:X.4.5.3 SR1). externalClause and fileGlobalExternalClause parse IS? EXTERNAL with the 2002 'AS literal' tail, which VisitExternalizedNamePhrase refuses at 85 (COBOL0900, probed on an FD and a 01); ClauseCardinalities refuses EXTERNAL written twice (COBOL2423), the SD grammar has no EXTERNAL (COBOL1970), and ClausePlacementRules refuses it on a 77, an 05 and in LINKAGE (COBOL2404). Probed at 85: EXTERNAL and IS EXTERNAL FDs of sequential, relative (dynamic) and indexed (dynamic) files written in one program and read, with an AT END, in a contained program through the shared connector; a failed OPEN (35) left the external connector closed, so a READ in another program got 47; the witness shares an EXTERNAL 01 between two programs. Sibling seen, not this row: VALUE subordinate to an EXTERNAL record compiles (kb/Work PB5072, SR-X.4.5.3-3).
